transcript.en_text: He is a classless, graceless, shameless barbarian.
transcript.zh_text: 他是个没有教养、毫无风度、不知廉耻的野蛮人。

highlights.zh_word: 没有教养、毫无风度、不知廉耻

transcript.en_text: What he did to you, Elizabeth, it was disgusting.
transcript.zh_text: 他对你做的那些事，伊丽莎白，太恶心了。

transcript.en_text: - Awful. - Just vile.
transcript.zh_text: ——太可怕了。——简直卑鄙。

transcript.en_text: - Can you pass the plate of... - Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: ——能把那盘……递过来吗？——好。

transcript.en_text: But why didn't you tell us?
transcript.zh_text: 可你为什么不告诉我们？

transcript.en_text: The thought of you fighting this alone, all those years...
transcript.zh_text: 一想到你这么多年独自扛着这些……

transcript.en_text: I didn't want pity.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想要同情。

transcript.en_text: Is it true that they were arguing?
transcript.zh_text: 他们真的在吵架吗？

transcript.en_text: No, she came down here to be with me.
transcript.zh_text: 不，她是下来陪我的。

transcript.en_text: Of course, we didn't expect that it was gonna be made a public display.
transcript.zh_text: 当然，我们没想到事情会被公之于众。

transcript.en_text: I guess he thought that was the best way to dispel the rumors.
transcript.zh_text: 我想他觉得那是消除谣言的最好方式。

transcript.en_text: That man does not deserve to be president.
transcript.zh_text: 那个人不配当总统。

transcript.en_text: I've never wanted to speak ill of him, Elizabeth, but when I think of the way he's treated you and Claire...
transcript.zh_text: 伊丽莎白，我一直不想说他的坏话，但一想到他对你和克莱尔……

transcript.en_text: Oh, stop now. He is still her son-in-law.
transcript.zh_text: 别说了。他还是她的女婿呢。

transcript.en_text: No, Bar's right.
transcript.zh_text: 不，巴尔说得对。

transcript.en_text: He doesn't deserve to be president.
transcript.zh_text: 他不配当总统。

transcript.en_text: You could... all help me, actually.
transcript.zh_text: 实际上，你们……都可以帮我。

transcript.en_text: - Anything. - Just say the word.
transcript.zh_text: ——什么都行。——你说吧。

transcript.en_text: Heather Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 希瑟·邓巴。

transcript.en_text: We should be supporting her.
transcript.zh_text: 我们应该支持她。

transcript.en_text: With our checkbooks.
transcript.zh_text: 用我们的支票簿。

transcript.en_text: You really want him to lose?
transcript.zh_text: 你真想让他输？

transcript.en_text: When he loses, Claire can begin her own career...
transcript.zh_text: 等他输了，克莱尔就可以开始自己的事业……

transcript.en_text: which is far more important to me.
transcript.zh_text: 这对我来说重要得多。

transcript.en_text: I don't know if we can really make a difference, but...
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道我们是否真能有所作为，但是……

transcript.en_text: I'd rather do more than just sit around and bad-mouth him.
transcript.zh_text: 我宁愿做点事，而不是坐在这里说他的坏话。

transcript.en_text: So, we just write a check?
transcript.zh_text: 那我们就开张支票？

transcript.en_text: Now, Francis can't know.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯不能知道。

transcript.en_text: I mean, our donations will have to be... once removed.
transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，我们的捐款得……间接进行。

transcript.en_text: That amendment has stalled for years.
transcript.zh_text: 那个修正案搁置好几年了。

transcript.en_text: Because we didn't have someone in Veterans Affairs.
transcript.zh_text: 因为我们在退伍军人事务部没有人。

transcript.en_text: It isn't a veterans issue. It's public health.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是退伍军人问题，这是公共卫生问题。

transcript.en_text: That's not my specialty.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是我的专业领域。

transcript.en_text: Wait, you're telling me you don't know anyone who's had breast cancer?
transcript.zh_text: 等等，你是说你不认识得过乳腺癌的人？

transcript.en_text: I mean in terms of legislation.
transcript.zh_text: 我说的是立法方面。

transcript.en_text: Fifty percent more.
transcript.zh_text: 多百分之五十。

transcript.en_text: That's how many more black women die of breast cancer than white women.
transcript.zh_text: 黑人女性死于乳腺癌的比率比白人女性高这么多。

transcript.en_text: In our district, it's higher than the murder rate.
transcript.zh_text: 在我们的选区，这个数字比谋杀率还高。

transcript.en_text: Help us get this clinic.
transcript.zh_text: 帮我们争取到这个诊所。

transcript.en_text: I don't deny that it's an important issue, but I have to pick and choose what I support.
transcript.zh_text: 我不否认这是个重要的问题，但我必须有所取舍。

transcript.en_text: You're in a tight race back home, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 你在家乡的竞选很紧张，女议员。

transcript.en_text: We'll set up a super PAC.
transcript.zh_text: 我们会成立一个超级政治行动委员会。

transcript.en_text: Three million dollars.
transcript.zh_text: 三百万美元。

transcript.en_text: You did this without talking to me?
transcript.zh_text: 你没跟我商量就这么做了？

transcript.en_text: Claire and I spoke at length, Mother.
transcript.zh_text: 我和克莱尔详细谈过了，妈。

transcript.en_text: Claire?
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔？

transcript.en_text: You're calling the First Lady by her given name, now?
transcript.zh_text: 你现在直接叫第一夫人的名字了？

transcript.en_text: Well, and I would hope you would, too, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我也希望你能这么叫，女议员。

transcript.en_text: You went behind my back, Mrs. Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 你背着我搞事情，安德伍德夫人。

transcript.en_text: I'm not asking for a full endorsement.
transcript.zh_text: 我不是要你公开支持。

transcript.en_text: I'm just asking for your blessing on Celia delaying her run.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想让你同意西莉亚推迟参选。

transcript.en_text: And of course, a promise to not campaign against me.
transcript.zh_text: 当然，还有你承诺不会反对我参选。

transcript.en_text: Jackie Sharp's big on Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 杰基·夏普很支持邓巴。

transcript.en_text: Why would she help you?
transcript.zh_text: 她为什么要帮你？

transcript.en_text: This money isn't directly linked to us.
transcript.zh_text: 这笔钱跟我们没有直接关联。

transcript.en_text: You mean the president's comfortable putting money in Jackie's war chest?
transcript.zh_text: 你是说总统愿意往杰基的竞选基金里投钱？

transcript.en_text: He is, but we have to keep this quiet.
transcript.zh_text: 他愿意，但我们得保密。

transcript.en_text: There can't be any communication between your office and his.
transcript.zh_text: 你的办公室和他的之间不能有任何沟通。

transcript.en_text: - Speech? - Seth put in your latest edits.
transcript.zh_text: ——演讲稿？——赛斯加入了你最新的修改。

transcript.en_text: Once you approve, we'll send it to the teleprompters.
transcript.zh_text: 你批准后，我们就发送到提词器。

transcript.en_text: - Has she arrived yet? - A few minutes ago.
transcript.zh_text: ——她到了吗？——几分钟前到的。

transcript.en_text: Please sit down.
transcript.zh_text: 请坐。

transcript.en_text: If Jackie gets cold feet, we can't leave her any choice.
transcript.zh_text: 如果杰基退缩了，我们不能给她留任何选择。

transcript.en_text: I'm already on top of that.
transcript.zh_text: 这事我已经在处理了。

transcript.en_text: How?
transcript.zh_text: 怎么处理的？

transcript.en_text: They always use the same hotel. I've got a guy set up across the street.
transcript.zh_text: 他们总用同一家酒店。我在对面安排了人。

transcript.en_text: I'm assuming you're being careful.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信你已经很小心了。

transcript.en_text: I'm not just a tech outfit. I can go old school, too.
transcript.zh_text: 我不只是搞技术的。传统手段我也会。

transcript.en_text: Ma'am? We have lunch prepared for you.
transcript.zh_text: 夫人？我们为您准备了午餐。

transcript.en_text: This is impressive.
transcript.zh_text: 真不错。

transcript.en_text: Well, soak it up while you can. We won't be here long.
transcript.zh_text: 好好享受吧。我们不会在这里待太久。

transcript.en_text: I'll be right back.
transcript.zh_text: 我马上回来。

transcript.en_text: Anatoly Rostropov. His empire's worth 30 billion.
transcript.zh_text: 阿纳托利·罗斯特罗波夫。他的商业帝国价值三百亿。

transcript.en_text: Petrov had him killed last night.
transcript.zh_text: 昨晚彼得罗夫让人杀了他。

transcript.en_text: Stanislav Ustravich, founder of Turkas Oil.
transcript.zh_text: 斯坦尼斯拉夫·乌斯特拉维奇，图尔卡斯石油公司创始人。

transcript.en_text: Found dead early this morning.
transcript.zh_text: 今早被发现死亡。

transcript.en_text: Igor Milkin, media tycoon worth 24 billion.
transcript.zh_text: 伊戈尔·米尔金，身价两百四十亿的传媒大亨。

transcript.en_text: Very outspoken against Petrov after the government seized his TV stations and newspapers.
transcript.zh_text: 在政府没收了他的电视台和报纸后，他公开反对彼得罗夫。

transcript.en_text: His private plane landed in Bangor, Maine, two hours ago.
transcript.zh_text: 他的私人飞机两小时前降落在缅因州班戈。

transcript.en_text: We've got him quarantined on the tarmac.
transcript.zh_text: 我们把他隔离在停机坪上了。

transcript.en_text: He's seeking political asylum. Says he's in fear for his life.
transcript.zh_text: 他在寻求政治避难。说他担心自己的生命安全。

transcript.en_text: We believe they've been formulating a plan to unseat Petrov.
transcript.zh_text: 我们认为他们一直在策划推翻彼得罗夫的计划。

transcript.en_text: Brutus, Cassius, and the one that got away.
transcript.zh_text: 布鲁图斯、卡西乌斯，以及那个漏网之鱼。

transcript.en_text: Moscow's adamant we send him back immediately.
transcript.zh_text: 莫斯科坚持要求我们立即遣返他。

transcript.en_text: Then send him back.
transcript.zh_text: 那就送他回去。

transcript.en_text: I don't want the State of the Union overshadowed by some asylum dispute.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想国情咨文被什么庇护纠纷抢了风头。

transcript.en_text: He's Petrov's problem, not ours.
transcript.zh_text: 他是彼得罗夫的问题，不是我们的。

transcript.en_text: Legally, sir, we are obligated to process his asylum request.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，从法律上讲，我们有义务处理他的庇护申请。

transcript.en_text: - Don't tell me the press knows he's here. - No, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——别告诉我媒体知道他在这里。——不，先生。

transcript.en_text: We jammed communications on his plane as soon as it entered U.S. airspace.
transcript.zh_text: 他的飞机一进入美国领空，我们就干扰了机上通讯。

transcript.en_text: Then we don't have a problem, do we?
transcript.zh_text: 那我们就没问题了，对吧？

transcript.en_text: It's likely he'll be killed if we send him back.
transcript.zh_text: 如果把他送回去，他很可能会被杀。

transcript.en_text: So be it. He tried to slay a dragon and he missed the mark.
transcript.zh_text: 那就随他去吧。他试图杀龙但没射中。

transcript.en_text: Now he's gotta face the fire.
transcript.zh_text: 现在他得面对烈火。

transcript.en_text: Our fear is more killings, more company seizures.
transcript.zh_text: 我们担心更多的杀戮、更多的公司被没收。

transcript.en_text: That leads to a run on the banks, collapse of the ruble, default on debts.
transcript.zh_text: 那会导致银行挤兑、卢布崩盘、债务违约。

transcript.en_text: And we already know he's been back-channeling about a bailout with the IMF.
transcript.zh_text: 而且我们已经知道他一直在跟国际货币基金组织暗中接触谈救助。

transcript.en_text: Well, if you have a proposal to make, then make it quickly.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，你如果有提议就赶紧说。

transcript.en_text: - I have a speech to prep for. - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——我还有演讲要准备。——好的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Last year you wore the taupe, so maybe this is too similar?
transcript.zh_text: 去年你穿了灰褐色的，这件会不会太像了？

transcript.en_text: Come in.
transcript.zh_text: 请进。

transcript.en_text: I was able to get Mrs. Hale on the phone.
transcript.zh_text: 我联系上了黑尔夫人。

transcript.en_text: Oh, great. Uh, could you excuse me for a moment?
transcript.zh_text: 太好了。呃，能让我单独说几句吗？

transcript.en_text: - Mother? - You doing okay, Mrs. Hale?
transcript.zh_text: ——妈？——你还好吗，黑尔夫人？

transcript.en_text: Yes, thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Who was that?
transcript.zh_text: 那是谁？

transcript.en_text: Oh, um...
transcript.zh_text: 哦，嗯……

transcript.en_text: I'm treating myself to a pedicure.
transcript.zh_text: 我在做足部护理犒劳一下自己。

transcript.en_text: Nobody can hear me.
transcript.zh_text: 没人能听到我。

transcript.en_text: You wanted to talk?
transcript.zh_text: 你想说什么？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I wanted to thank you, for all of your help.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我想谢谢你的帮忙。

transcript.en_text: Uh, it looks like the congresswoman is leaning toward a yes.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，看起来那位女议员倾向于同意了。

transcript.en_text: You know, I was thinking, when you run, you should use your maiden name instead.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道，我在想，你参选时应该用你的娘家姓。

transcript.en_text: Mother, I couldn't do that. It would look bad.
transcript.zh_text: 妈，我不能那样做。那样会不好看的。

transcript.en_text: Mmm... Well, then how about if you...
transcript.zh_text: 嗯……那你要不要……

transcript.en_text: if you use Claire Hale-Underwood?
transcript.zh_text: 用克莱尔·黑尔-安德伍德？

transcript.en_text: That has a nice ring to it.
transcript.zh_text: 听起来不错。

highlights.en_word: has a nice ring to it

transcript.en_text: Maybe.
transcript.zh_text: 也许吧。

transcript.en_text: - Have you seen him yet? - No, not yet.
transcript.zh_text: ——你见到他了吗？——还没有。

transcript.en_text: What are you gonna wear tonight?
transcript.zh_text: 你今晚打算穿什么？

transcript.en_text: I was just deciding that now, actually.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚好在决定这件事。

transcript.en_text: Something dark, I hope.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望穿深色的。

transcript.en_text: Well, it's between black and ivory, and to tell you the truth, this ivory is so beautiful-- Oh, for God's sakes, don't wear ivory.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，选择在黑色和象牙白之间，说实话这件象牙白真的很漂亮—— 天哪，别穿象牙白。

transcript.en_text: Even with your figure, it'll accentuate all the wrong places.
transcript.zh_text: 就算你身材再好，它也会让不该突出的地方更突出。

transcript.en_text: Are you going to watch the speech?
transcript.zh_text: 你要看演讲吗？

transcript.en_text: Mother?
transcript.zh_text: 妈？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I'm gonna...
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我会……

transcript.en_text: I'm gonna have Michael put a TV in the bedroom.
transcript.zh_text: 我让迈克尔在卧室里放一台电视。

transcript.en_text: Mrs. Underwood, the president is ready for you.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人，总统准备好了。

transcript.en_text: I'll be right out.
transcript.zh_text: 我马上出来。

transcript.en_text: Mother, I have to go.
transcript.zh_text: 妈，我得走了。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I-- Of course. I'm sure you must be very busy.
transcript.zh_text: 好的——当然。你肯定很忙。

transcript.en_text: I'll see you when I get home?
transcript.zh_text: 我回来后见你？

transcript.en_text: If I'm asleep...
transcript.zh_text: 如果我睡着了……

transcript.en_text: Then I'll see you in the morning.
transcript.zh_text: 那我早上见你。

transcript.en_text: Goodbye, Mother.
transcript.zh_text: 再见，妈。

transcript.en_text: Bye. Wear the black!
transcript.zh_text: 再见。穿黑色的！

transcript.en_text: I don't want even the slightest chance this gets out.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想有丝毫泄露的可能。

transcript.en_text: We set up a perimeter. And we'll cover the tail number.
transcript.zh_text: 我们设了警戒线。我们会遮住机尾号。

transcript.en_text: Good. Set up a call with Petrov, for after the speech.
transcript.zh_text: 好。安排跟彼得罗夫的通话，演讲之后。

transcript.en_text: It'll be 5:00 a.m. in Moscow.
transcript.zh_text: 那时莫斯科是凌晨五点。

transcript.en_text: Oh, I guarantee he'll be watching.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我保证他会在看的。

transcript.en_text: Sir? I think you should take this.
transcript.zh_text: 先生？我觉得您应该接这个电话。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me.
transcript.zh_text: 失陪一下。

transcript.en_text: Hello, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 你好，女议员。

transcript.en_text: Sorry for the delay. Please sit down.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉让你久等了。请坐。

transcript.en_text: Did you get the earrings?
transcript.zh_text: 你收到耳环了吗？

transcript.en_text: I did. Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 收到了。谢谢。

transcript.en_text: My mother's. Two-carat diamonds.
transcript.zh_text: 是我母亲的。两克拉钻石。

transcript.en_text: For tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 给你今晚戴的。

transcript.en_text: There's nothing quite like diamond earrings.
transcript.zh_text: 没有什么比钻石耳环更好了。

transcript.en_text: Shall we begin?
transcript.zh_text: 我们开始吧？

transcript.en_text: Uh, this year, we're handling the arrival a bit differently.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，今年我们的入场安排做了点调整。

transcript.en_text: You'll be escorted to the rotunda for a photo op with the leadership before going to the holding room.
transcript.zh_text: 你会被护送到圆形大厅，先跟领导层拍照，然后再去候场室。

transcript.en_text: I don't need to go to the holding room. You can take me directly to the gallery.
transcript.zh_text: 我不需要去候场室。你直接带我去贵宾席就行。

transcript.en_text: Yes, that's fine. Whatever the First Lady prefers.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，可以。第一夫人怎么方便就怎么来。

transcript.en_text: And we'll need two separate motorcades after.
transcript.zh_text: 而且我们之后需要两个单独的车队。

transcript.en_text: I'll be going straight to the airport.
transcript.zh_text: 我要直接去安德鲁斯空军基地。

transcript.en_text: - Two motorcades, then. - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——两个车队。——好的，先生。

transcript.en_text: I'd like to brief you on the list of special guests attending-- This all seems pretty straightforward.
transcript.zh_text: 我想给你介绍一下出席的特邀嘉宾名单—— 看起来都很简单明了。

transcript.en_text: I'm good if you are.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你没问题我就没问题了。

transcript.en_text: Yes, I'm fine. Thank you so very much.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，很好。非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: Do you have a moment?
transcript.zh_text: 你有空吗？

transcript.en_text: How's Elizabeth?
transcript.zh_text: 伊丽莎白怎么样？

transcript.en_text: She sends her regards.
transcript.zh_text: 她问你好。

transcript.en_text: I'll bet she does.
transcript.zh_text: 我猜也是。

transcript.en_text: And the campaign?
transcript.zh_text: 竞选怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Still exploring viability.
transcript.zh_text: 还在评估可行性。

transcript.en_text: Doris isn't on board yet?
transcript.zh_text: 多里斯还没表态？

transcript.en_text: Uh, we'll see.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，走着看吧。

transcript.en_text: What have you offered her?
transcript.zh_text: 你开了什么条件？

transcript.en_text: Well, I want to put together a solid campaign strategy with LeAnn before engaging her again.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我想先和莱安制定一个完善的竞选策略再联系她。

transcript.en_text: Well, if you need my help, let me know. She and I were very close when I was whip.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，需要我帮忙就说。她跟我当党鞭时关系很近。

highlights.zh_word: 党鞭（国会中的政党纪律委员）

transcript.en_text: - You've got a lot on your plate. - No, it's no trouble at all.
transcript.zh_text: ——你已经够忙的了。——没事，不麻烦。

transcript.en_text: I'll let you know.
transcript.zh_text: 到时候告诉你。

transcript.en_text: See you tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚见。

transcript.en_text: You ready to prep, sir?
transcript.zh_text: 准备好排练了吗，先生？

transcript.en_text: - I need to make some changes. - I'll call the speech writers.
transcript.zh_text: ——我需要做些修改。——我去叫演讲稿撰写人。

transcript.en_text: No, I wanna do these myself. And track down Calista.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我想自己改。还有帮我找到卡莉斯塔。

transcript.en_text: We have to make room for one more guest.
transcript.zh_text: 还得再加一位嘉宾的座位。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，先生。

transcript.en_text: Oh! Ah.
transcript.zh_text: 哦！啊。

transcript.en_text: What's that?
transcript.zh_text: 那是什么？

transcript.en_text: I'm having it removed.
transcript.zh_text: 我在把它去掉。

transcript.en_text: Well, that's too bad. I liked it.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，那太可惜了。我挺喜欢的。

transcript.en_text: Hmm, time to move on.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，是时候往前看了。

transcript.en_text: From what?
transcript.zh_text: 从什么开始？

transcript.en_text: From the me that needed a tattoo.
transcript.zh_text: 从那个需要纹身的我。

transcript.en_text: I don't have much time.
transcript.zh_text: 我没什么时间了。

transcript.en_text: When do you have to be at the Capitol?
transcript.zh_text: 你什么时候得到国会大厦？

transcript.en_text: Less than an hour.
transcript.zh_text: 不到一小时后。

transcript.en_text: - Whiskey or vodka? - Vodka.
transcript.zh_text: ——威士忌还是伏特加？——伏特加。

transcript.en_text: How well do you know Doris Jones?
transcript.zh_text: 你对多里斯·琼斯了解多少？

transcript.en_text: Oh, uh, met her a few times. I don't know her that well, though.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，见过她几次。不太了解她。

transcript.en_text: - Why? - Her daughter, Celia, wants me to help them get appropriations for a breast cancer clinic.
transcript.zh_text: ——为什么问？——她女儿西莉亚想让我帮她们争取乳腺癌诊所的拨款。

transcript.en_text: In return, they want to pad my campaign with Texas money.
transcript.zh_text: 作为交换，她们想用德州的钱来资助我的竞选。

transcript.en_text: - How much? - Three million.
transcript.zh_text: ——多少？——三百万。

transcript.en_text: To start.
transcript.zh_text: 先打底。

transcript.en_text: Her district doesn't have that kind of money.
transcript.zh_text: 她的选区拿不出那种钱。

transcript.en_text: Celia says they're courting donors from outside the 30th.
transcript.zh_text: 西莉亚说她们在第三十选区以外拉赞助。

transcript.en_text: But one of my aides heard that Claire Underwood and LeAnn Harvey were in Jones' office today.
transcript.zh_text: 但我一个助手听说克莱尔·安德伍德和莱安·哈维今天去了琼斯的办公室。

transcript.en_text: Huh...
LeAnn's someone I know.
transcript.zh_text: 莱安我认识。

transcript.en_text: Glendon Hill was courting her a few years ago.
transcript.zh_text: 前几年格伦登希尔公司在招揽她。

transcript.en_text: Did she turn you down?
transcript.zh_text: 她拒绝你了？

transcript.en_text: We couldn't afford her.
transcript.zh_text: 我们请不起她。

transcript.en_text: Look, I know you're out of the game, but this is a lot of money.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我知道你已经退出了，但这可是一大笔钱。

transcript.en_text: If it's legit, it could really help me. But if it's not, I-- I'll talk to LeAnn and see what I can find out.
transcript.zh_text: 如果是合法的对我帮助很大。但如果不是—— 我会去找莱安打听一下。

transcript.en_text: Here.
transcript.zh_text: 给。

transcript.en_text: I want to taste you first.
transcript.zh_text: 我想先尝尝你的味道。

transcript.en_text: Hey!
transcript.zh_text: 嘿！

transcript.en_text: This is a special report.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一则特别报道。

transcript.en_text: President Francis Underwood's State of the Union address to a joint session of Congress.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯·安德伍德总统向国会两院发表国情咨文。

transcript.en_text: Tonight the eyes of the world are on Washington.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚全世界的目光都聚焦在华盛顿。

transcript.en_text: President Underwood will take the stage in just a few minutes...
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德总统几分钟后就要登台了……

transcript.en_text: Take the food away.
transcript.zh_text: 把食物拿走。

transcript.en_text: You didn't eat your lunch, Mrs. Hale.
transcript.zh_text: 您没吃午饭，黑尔夫人。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, well, I didn't feel well.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我不太舒服。

transcript.en_text: Then you really should eat dinner. Your medication-- Please don't make me ask you again, Michael.
transcript.zh_text: 那您更应该吃晚饭。您的药—— 请不要让我再说一遍，迈克尔。

transcript.en_text: Just take it away. The smell of it is making me ill.
transcript.zh_text: 把它拿走就好。那味道让我恶心。

transcript.en_text: Yes, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，夫人。

transcript.en_text: Ladies and gentlemen, the First Lady of the United States.
transcript.zh_text: 女士们先生们，美利坚合众国第一夫人。

transcript.en_text: - Celia. - Thank you so much for arranging this.
transcript.zh_text: ——西莉亚。——非常感谢你的安排。

transcript.en_text: It's a big honor to be sitting next to you.
transcript.zh_text: 能坐在你旁边是很大的荣幸。

transcript.en_text: Mr. Speaker, the President of the United States.
transcript.zh_text: 议长先生，美利坚合众国总统。

transcript.en_text: - Interesting place to watch the SOTU. - Ah.
transcript.zh_text: ——看国情咨文选了个有趣的地方。——啊。

transcript.en_text: It's more fun this way. You know, hanging with the hoi polloi.
transcript.zh_text: 这样更有意思。你知道的，跟普通人混在一起。

transcript.en_text: So, what brings you to D.C.?
transcript.zh_text: 那你来华盛顿是为什么？

transcript.en_text: Well, all of Congress in town, it's good for hustling work.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，国会议员都在城里，正好可以拉生意。

transcript.en_text: Since when do you hustle? You turn people away.
transcript.zh_text: 你什么时候需要拉生意了？找你的人都排不过来。

transcript.en_text: How'd you know I was in town?
transcript.zh_text: 你怎么知道我在城里？

transcript.en_text: I might be retired, but I still have my ear to the ground.
transcript.zh_text: 我虽然退休了，但消息还是很灵通的。

transcript.en_text: So that's true? The great Remy Danton has hung up his jersey?
transcript.zh_text: 那是真的？伟大的雷米·丹顿真的挂靴了？

transcript.en_text: I've never felt better.
transcript.zh_text: 我从没感觉这么好过。

transcript.en_text: - Don't tell me this is a social visit. - No.
transcript.zh_text: ——别告诉我你只是社交拜访。——不是。

transcript.en_text: - Well, if it isn't business... - It's business.
transcript.zh_text: ——那如果不是生意的话……——是生意。

transcript.en_text: - Members of Congress... - Okay.
transcript.zh_text: ——国会议员们……——好吧。

transcript.en_text: - ...I have the high privilege... - So...
transcript.zh_text: ——……我非常荣幸……——那么……

transcript.en_text: - Oh, hold on. The show is starting. - ...of presenting to you, the President of the United States.
transcript.zh_text: ——哦，等等。表演要开始了。——……向你们介绍，美利坚合众国总统。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Thank you so much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: Thank you. Mr. Speaker, Mr. Vice President, members of Congress, my fellow Americans.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。议长先生，副总统先生，各位国会议员，我的美国同胞们。

transcript.en_text: One year ago, when I gave this address for the first time, it was during a very different period for our country.
transcript.zh_text: 一年前，当我第一次发表这篇演讲时，我们国家正处于一个截然不同的时期。

transcript.en_text: Our nation was recovering from a political scandal and a trade crisis with China.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的国家正在从一场政治丑闻和对华贸易危机中恢复。

transcript.en_text: Before you stood a president no one had elected.
transcript.zh_text: 站在你们面前的是一位没有人选举产生的总统。

transcript.en_text: But that same man stands before you now, and the darkness is behind us.
transcript.zh_text: 但那同一个人现在站在你们面前，黑暗已经过去。

transcript.en_text: The state of the union is bright, and getting brighter.
transcript.zh_text: 联邦的状况是光明的，而且越来越好。

transcript.en_text: We've had our challenges, yes.
transcript.zh_text: 我们确实有过挑战。

transcript.en_text: Particularly with Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 特别是和俄罗斯。

transcript.en_text: There were some tense moments, to be sure, and yet we overcame those tensions.
transcript.zh_text: 确实有过一些紧张的时刻，但我们克服了那些紧张局势。

transcript.en_text: President Petrov let us continue to build trust and show that we've learned from our experiences last year.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫总统让我们得以继续建立信任，表明我们已从去年的经历中吸取教训。

transcript.en_text: And I'd personally like to acknowledge the First Lady, who led the way in repairing those burned bridges.
transcript.zh_text: 我想特别感谢第一夫人，她在修复那些被烧毁的桥梁方面起了带头作用。

transcript.en_text: She's getting more applause than the president.
transcript.zh_text: 她得到的掌声比总统还多。

transcript.en_text: Good for you, isn't it?
transcript.zh_text: 对你来说挺好的吧？

transcript.en_text: Quite a high-profile client.
transcript.zh_text: 一个相当高调的客户。

transcript.en_text: Who told you that?
transcript.zh_text: 谁告诉你的？

transcript.en_text: - Just a guess. - No, you guessed wrong.
transcript.zh_text: ——只是猜的。——不，你猜错了。

transcript.en_text: So what do you know about big Texas donors...
transcript.zh_text: 那你对德州大金主了解多少……

transcript.en_text: who care enough about a poor Dallas district to donate money to a campaign in California?
transcript.zh_text: 关心达拉斯穷选区到愿意捐钱给加州竞选的那种？

transcript.en_text: That went right over my head.
transcript.zh_text: 我完全不知道你在说什么。

transcript.en_text: First Lady was in Dallas. You were in Dallas.
transcript.zh_text: 第一夫人去了达拉斯。你也在达拉斯。

transcript.en_text: The First Lady is here.
transcript.zh_text: 第一夫人在这里。

transcript.en_text: Now you're here.
transcript.zh_text: 现在你也在这里。

transcript.en_text: I think you have far too much time on your hands, Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得你空闲时间太多了，雷米。

transcript.en_text: Your fingerprints are all over this money.
transcript.zh_text: 你的指纹沾满了这笔钱。

highlights.zh_word: 指纹沾满（暗指参与其中）

transcript.en_text: You're working for Jackie Sharp now?
transcript.zh_text: 你现在为杰基·夏普工作了？

transcript.en_text: No. Just friends.
transcript.zh_text: 不。只是朋友。

transcript.en_text: - Just friends, huh? - Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: ——只是朋友？——是的。

transcript.en_text: I think your fingerprints are all over her.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得你的指纹沾满了她身上。

transcript.en_text: How about this?
transcript.zh_text: 这样如何？

transcript.en_text: You don't poke around in my shit...
transcript.zh_text: 你不要在我的事情里刨根问底……

transcript.en_text: and I won't poke around in yours.
transcript.zh_text: 我就不在你的事情里刨根问底。

transcript.en_text: It was good to see you, Remy. Don't get too soft in retirement.
transcript.zh_text: 很高兴见到你，雷米。退休了别太安逸。

transcript.en_text: Now, it's considered uncouth for a president who's in the midst of a campaign, to talk directly about the upcoming election, but tonight, I feel compelled.
transcript.zh_text: 总统在竞选期间直接谈论即将到来的大选被认为是不合时宜的，但今晚我觉得有必要说几句。

transcript.en_text: Because the votes our electorate casts during the current primaries and the general election in November will have a profound impact on everyone in this room.
transcript.zh_text: 因为选民在当前初选和十一月大选中投下的选票将对在座的每一个人产生深远影响。

transcript.en_text: Some of us, myself included, may find ourselves out of a job.
transcript.zh_text: 我们中的一些人，包括我自己，可能会发现自己丢了工作。

transcript.en_text: If we want to keep our jobs, we have to listen to the American people.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们想保住工作，就必须倾听美国人民的声音。

transcript.en_text: We have to work harder! We have to deliver!
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须更加努力！我们必须拿出成果！

transcript.en_text: Just like Doris Jones.
transcript.zh_text: 就像多里斯·琼斯一样。

transcript.en_text: She has kept her job in Congress for 34 years because she never relented in the face of adversity.
transcript.zh_text: 她在国会保住了三十四年的席位，因为她在逆境面前从不退缩。

transcript.en_text: In fact, just today, she called me about a breast cancer clinic she has been fighting for over the past decade.
transcript.zh_text: 事实上就在今天，她给我打电话说起一个她过去十年一直在争取的乳腺癌诊所。

transcript.en_text: Now, her plan is bold.
transcript.zh_text: 她的计划很大胆。

transcript.en_text: A VA hospital expansion open to the general public, financed by federal money.
transcript.zh_text: 扩建退伍军人医院、向公众开放，由联邦资金资助。

transcript.en_text: A bold plan that will significantly increase successful diagnoses and treatment through education, screenings, and affordable care.
transcript.zh_text: 一个大胆的计划，将通过教育、筛查和可负担医疗显著提高诊断和治疗成功率。

transcript.en_text: Now, she's gotten resistance, time and again...
transcript.zh_text: 她一次又一次地遭到阻力……

transcript.en_text: from the Veterans Affairs administration, from her colleagues in Congress...
transcript.zh_text: 来自退伍军人事务部，来自她在国会的同僚……

transcript.en_text: - Can you turn it up a bit? - ...from those who don't want to see government funds going to Planned Parenthood.
transcript.zh_text: ——能调大点声吗？——……来自那些不想看到政府资金流向计划生育组织的人。

transcript.en_text: And yet, when she called me today, she was just as passionate about this clinic as she was when she first brought it up to me ten years ago.
transcript.zh_text: 然而当她今天给我打电话时，她对诊所的热情跟十年前第一次跟我提起时一样强烈。

transcript.en_text: Well, Doris, it worked.
transcript.zh_text: 好了多里斯，你的坚持有了成果。

transcript.en_text: I'll be working with the Secretary of Veterans Affairs, HUD and the congressional leaders to get you that clinic.
transcript.zh_text: 我将与退伍军人事务部长、住房与城市发展部以及国会领袖合作，帮你拿到那个诊所。

transcript.en_text: Because of you, we'll save lives.
transcript.zh_text: 因为有了你，我们将拯救生命。

transcript.en_text: And that is exactly the sort of leadership the American people want.
transcript.zh_text: 这就是美国人民想要的那种领导力。

transcript.en_text: More leaders like Doris Jones.
transcript.zh_text: 更多像多里斯·琼斯这样的领导者。

transcript.en_text: And when she retires at the end of this term, I'm delighted to say that her daughter, Celia, will run for the open seat to continue delivering just like her mother has.
transcript.zh_text: 当她在本届任期结束时退休，我很高兴地说她的女儿西莉亚将竞选空出的席位，继续像她母亲一样为民服务。

transcript.en_text: No fucking way.
transcript.zh_text: 他妈的不可能。

transcript.en_text: And I, for one, will support your candidacy with everything I've got.
transcript.zh_text: 我个人将全力支持你的候选。

transcript.en_text: And I know Claire will, as well.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道克莱尔也会的。

transcript.en_text: Texans are tenacious.
transcript.zh_text: 德州人很顽强。

transcript.en_text: I'm proud to be married to one, and I'm proud to have served with one, like Congresswoman Jones.
transcript.zh_text: 我为嫁给了一个德州人而骄傲，也为曾与琼斯女议员这样的德州人共事而骄傲。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Doris, for all your years of service, and thank you, Celia, for picking up the mantle.
transcript.zh_text: 感谢你多里斯多年的服务，也感谢你西莉亚接过了这面旗帜。

transcript.en_text: Doris said her daughter spoke out of turn, that she didn't know about the deal she was brokering with Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 多里斯说她女儿说话太草率了，她并不知道西莉亚跟安德伍德谈的交易。

transcript.en_text: Did you connect with LeAnn?
transcript.zh_text: 你联系上莱安了吗？

transcript.en_text: No, I didn't.
transcript.zh_text: 不，没有。

transcript.en_text: She said she couldn't meet until tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 她说明天才能见面。

transcript.en_text: Well, I guess there's no point now, anyway.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，反正现在也没什么意义了。

transcript.en_text: If the White House is orchestrating the funding, Underwood's not gonna want my help.
transcript.zh_text: 如果白宫在操控资金，安德伍德不会要我的帮助。

transcript.en_text: Fuck! I really could've used that money.
transcript.zh_text: 操！我真的很需要那笔钱。

transcript.en_text: Well, when it looks too good to be true...
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，当事情看起来好得不像真的……

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I know.
transcript.zh_text: 是啊，我知道。

transcript.en_text: When am I gonna see you again?
transcript.zh_text: 我什么时候能再见到你？

transcript.en_text: Um... I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯……我不知道。

transcript.en_text: I've been... feeling a bit stir-crazy.
transcript.zh_text: 我一直……觉得有些憋闷。

transcript.en_text: If I'm retired, I should probably travel some.
transcript.zh_text: 既然退休了，也许应该出去走走。

transcript.en_text: Well, you could travel to California.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，你可以来加州。

transcript.en_text: I'll be there more than here until November.
transcript.zh_text: 到十一月之前我在那边的时间会比这里多。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, maybe.
transcript.zh_text: 也许吧。

transcript.en_text: Or don't.
transcript.zh_text: 或者别来。

transcript.en_text: You know how to reach me.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道怎么联系我。

transcript.en_text: Do you think it was Remy?
transcript.zh_text: 你觉得是雷米吗？

transcript.en_text: Highly doubtful. I made it clear what we knew.
transcript.zh_text: 非常不可能。我已经表明了我们知道什么。

transcript.en_text: He knows you have proof?
transcript.zh_text: 他知道你有证据？

transcript.en_text: He knows that I know. Not that I have proof.
transcript.zh_text: 他知道我知道。但不知道我有证据。

transcript.en_text: Maybe we shouldn't have played that card yet.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我们不应该那么早亮出那张牌。

transcript.en_text: Remy was connecting the dots.
transcript.zh_text: 雷米在把事情串起来。

transcript.en_text: I needed to put the brakes on him.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要让他刹车。

transcript.en_text: Well, if it wasn't him, Doris must've gone to Francis himself.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，如果不是他，那多里斯一定是直接找了弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: She saw an opening and-- Ma'am, there's been a change of plans.
transcript.zh_text: 她看到了机会然后—— 夫人，计划有变。

transcript.en_text: Uh, hold on. What change of plans?
transcript.zh_text: 呃，等等。什么计划变了？

transcript.en_text: We're taking you back to the White House.
transcript.zh_text: 我们要送您回白宫。

transcript.en_text: No, we're going to Andrews.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我们要去安德鲁斯。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, this is direct from the president.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，这是总统直接下达的命令。

transcript.en_text: This is not gonna be as difficult as it seems.
transcript.zh_text: 这不会像看起来那么难。

transcript.en_text: Now, Terry's gonna be in touch with Veteran Affairs first thing tomorrow to draft an amendment.
transcript.zh_text: 特里明天一早会联系退伍军人事务部起草修正案。

transcript.en_text: And if the Republicans give us any resistance in committee, I'll start making calls.
transcript.zh_text: 如果共和党人在委员会里给我们阻力，我会开始打电话。

transcript.en_text: No reason why this can't get to the floor before the end of the session.
transcript.zh_text: 没有理由这件事不能在本届会期结束前提交审议。

transcript.en_text: Well, thank you, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，谢谢您，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Thank yourself. You played this well.
transcript.zh_text: 你自己的功劳。你处理得很好。

transcript.en_text: How did you play it?
transcript.zh_text: 你是怎么做到的？

transcript.en_text: Well, now, that's our little secret, isn't it?
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，那是我们之间的小秘密，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: I'll walk you out.
transcript.zh_text: 我送你出去。

transcript.en_text: Uh, Mr. President, I got this.
transcript.zh_text: 呃，总统先生，我来就好。

transcript.en_text: Oh, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: Didn't the president make the most wonderful speech?
transcript.zh_text: 总统是不是发表了一场精彩的演讲？

transcript.en_text: Oh, he certainly did.
transcript.zh_text: 确实如此。

transcript.en_text: And I thank you for convincing the president to mention Celia in his remarks.
transcript.zh_text: 我感谢你说服总统在讲话中提到了西莉亚。

transcript.en_text: Well, it was my pleasure.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，这是我的荣幸。

transcript.en_text: - Good night. - Good night.
transcript.zh_text: ——晚安。——晚安。

transcript.en_text: Good night, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: We had a deal.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有协议的。

transcript.en_text: I showed up.
transcript.zh_text: 我出席了。

transcript.en_text: And used that opportunity to undermine the campaign.
transcript.zh_text: 然后利用这个机会来破坏竞选。

transcript.en_text: Why didn't you just ask me?
transcript.zh_text: 你为什么不直接问我？

transcript.en_text: If you needed the clinic to convince Doris-- You don't want me to run, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你需要诊所来说服多里斯—— 你不想让我参选，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: That's right, I don't. But we'd reached an understanding.
transcript.zh_text: 没错，我不想。但我们已经达成了共识。

transcript.en_text: I think you said what you wanted me to hear.
transcript.zh_text: 我觉得你只是说了我想听的话。

transcript.en_text: Well, then you misread me.
transcript.zh_text: 那是你理解错了。

transcript.en_text: I am looking out for myself. Just like you are.
transcript.zh_text: 我在为自己考虑。就像你一样。

transcript.en_text: And where did that get you, looking out for yourself instead of looking out for us?
transcript.zh_text: 那你为自己考虑的结果呢？只顾自己而不顾我们？

transcript.en_text: The 30th is dead now. You know that.
transcript.zh_text: 第三十选区现在完了。你知道的。

transcript.en_text: You think I'm giving up?
transcript.zh_text: 你以为我会放弃？

transcript.en_text: What, you're gonna run against the Joneses?
transcript.zh_text: 什么，你要跟琼斯家族竞争？

transcript.en_text: You'll make a fool of yourself, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 你会让自己出丑的，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: The odds were against you even with their blessing.
transcript.zh_text: 即使有他们的支持，胜算也不大。

transcript.en_text: Now, I hoped you'd reach that conclusion on your own.
transcript.zh_text: 我本来希望你能自己想通。

highlights.en_word: reach that conclusion on your own

transcript.en_text: But instead, you lied to me.
transcript.zh_text: 但你却对我撒谎。

transcript.en_text: Now, I can't force you to see reason.
transcript.zh_text: 我无法强迫你看清现实。

transcript.en_text: But I will not allow you to become dangerous.
transcript.zh_text: 但我不会允许你变得危险。

transcript.en_text: I'll take one.
transcript.zh_text: 我来一支。

transcript.en_text: Take mine.
transcript.zh_text: 抽我的。

transcript.en_text: Claire, look...
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔，听我说……

transcript.en_text: When I win the general, then we can concentrate on a Senate seat for you in Texas.
transcript.zh_text: 等我赢了大选，我们就可以集中精力在德州给你争取一个参议院席位。

transcript.en_text: You don't want to be in the House, anyway.
transcript.zh_text: 你也不想待在众议院。

transcript.en_text: And neither of us could have predicted a Heather Dunbar, or how formidable she'd be.
transcript.zh_text: 我们谁都没预料到会出现希瑟·邓巴这样的人，或者她会如此强劲。

transcript.en_text: We are fighting for our lives here.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在是在为生死而战。

transcript.en_text: And when you run, you wanna do so from a position of strength.
transcript.zh_text: 而当你参选的时候，你要从一个有利的位置出发。

transcript.en_text: It's about timing.
transcript.zh_text: 这是时机的问题。

transcript.en_text: Maybe it's too soon. Maybe you're right.
transcript.zh_text: 也许太早了。也许你是对的。

transcript.en_text: But I need to think.
transcript.zh_text: 但我需要想一想。

transcript.en_text: Fair enough.
transcript.zh_text: 可以。

transcript.en_text: I can't do that here.
transcript.zh_text: 我不能在这里想。

transcript.en_text: Back in Texas?
transcript.zh_text: 回德州？

transcript.en_text: I'm not sure how long I'll need.
transcript.zh_text: 我不确定需要多长时间。

transcript.en_text: Well, take as long as you want.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，想待多久就待多久。

transcript.en_text: I should get going.
transcript.zh_text: 我该走了。

transcript.en_text: It's late. You sure you don't want to spend the night?
transcript.zh_text: 太晚了。你确定不想在这过夜？

transcript.en_text: - Well, Mother was expecting me. - All right.
transcript.zh_text: ——妈在等我呢。——好吧。

transcript.en_text: I'll walk myself out. You enjoy your drink.
transcript.zh_text: 我自己走出去就好。你享用你的酒吧。

transcript.en_text: You know, there was a boy that lived down the street from me in Gaffney.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道，我在加夫尼的时候街上住了个男孩。

transcript.en_text: About my age. His name was Walter Wryson.
transcript.zh_text: 跟我差不多大。他叫沃尔特·赖森。

transcript.en_text: He used to run away from home all the time and come to our house.
transcript.zh_text: 他总是从家里跑出来，跑到我们家。

transcript.en_text: Not for any good reason.
transcript.zh_text: 也没什么正当理由。

transcript.en_text: His daddy didn't beat him. He had clothes on his back.
transcript.zh_text: 他爸没打过他。他穿得也不差。

transcript.en_text: The Wrysons had way more money than we did, but run away he would, at least once a month and come straight to our place.
transcript.zh_text: 赖森家比我们有钱得多，但他每月至少跑出来一次，直奔我们家。

transcript.en_text: Now, usually, my mother would call his mother and she'd come and fetch him.
transcript.zh_text: 通常我妈会打电话给他妈，她妈就来接他。

transcript.en_text: But about the ninth or tenth time this happened, Walter ran outside, climbed up into a tree in our backyard, and wouldn't come down for nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 但大约第九次还是第十次的时候，沃尔特跑到外面，爬上了我们后院的一棵树，死活不下来。

transcript.en_text: Now, my mama said to his mama, "Why don't you let us keep him for a while, until he feels like coming home?"
transcript.zh_text: 我妈跟他妈说，'让他在我们这里待一阵吧，直到他想回家为止。'

transcript.en_text: But man, oh, man, that boy was stubborn.
transcript.zh_text: 但天哪，那孩子真倔。

transcript.en_text: Night came, and he was still up there.
transcript.zh_text: 天黑了，他还在上面。

transcript.en_text: No food, no water... no toilet.
transcript.zh_text: 没有食物，没有水……也没法上厕所。

transcript.en_text: And just before I went to bed, I looked out my window and I heard him crying.
transcript.zh_text: 就在我上床前，我从窗户望出去，听到他在哭。

transcript.en_text: And I said, "Walter, why don't you come on down?"
transcript.zh_text: 我说，'沃尔特，你怎么不下来呢？'

transcript.en_text: And he just shook his head no.
transcript.zh_text: 他只是摇了摇头。

transcript.en_text: Well, the next morning, I woke up, I looked out the window and Walter was still up in that tree.
transcript.zh_text: 第二天早上我醒来，从窗户往外看，沃尔特还在那棵树上。

transcript.en_text: So after breakfast, I walked over with a plate of eggs...
transcript.zh_text: 于是吃完早饭，我端了一盘鸡蛋走过去……

transcript.en_text: and I asked him if he wanted some.
transcript.zh_text: 问他要不要来点。

transcript.en_text: And again, he just shook his head.
transcript.zh_text: 他又摇了摇头。

transcript.en_text: And I got angry.
transcript.zh_text: 我生气了。

transcript.en_text: That boy had a good house, a good family, the sort I would've killed for, and he didn't even realize it.
transcript.zh_text: 那男孩有好房子、好家庭，那种我做梦都想要的，可他竟然不知道珍惜。

transcript.en_text: So I went into the tool shed and I took out an ax.
transcript.zh_text: 于是我走进工具棚，拿出一把斧头。

transcript.en_text: And I said to Walter...
transcript.zh_text: 我对沃尔特说……

transcript.en_text: "You want to know what it's really like to live at my house?"
transcript.zh_text: '你想知道住在我家是什么感觉吗？'

transcript.en_text: And I gave that tree a good whack. And Walter cried out, but I kept on.
transcript.zh_text: 我朝那棵树狠狠砍了一下。沃尔特大叫起来，但我没停。

highlights.en_word: gave that tree a good whack

transcript.en_text: I mean, you've never heard screams like the one coming from Walter as I chopped at that tree.
transcript.zh_text: 你从来没听过那种尖叫，从沃尔特嘴里发出来的，我一边砍那棵树。

transcript.en_text: He pissed his pants, and it came raining down on the ground, but I didn't pay it no mind.
transcript.zh_text: 他吓得尿裤子了，尿从树上淋了下来，但我没在意。

transcript.en_text: I just kept whacking away.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是继续砍。

transcript.en_text: Well...
it didn't take long before Walter was on the ground and running back to his house.
transcript.zh_text: 没过多久沃尔特就在地上了，跑回了他家。

transcript.en_text: You see, all he needed was a little motivation.
transcript.zh_text: 你看，他需要的只是一点动力。

transcript.en_text: So I'll give Claire some time.
transcript.zh_text: 所以我会给克莱尔一些时间。

transcript.en_text: But for her sake, I hope she comes out of her tree before I have to bring out my ax.
transcript.zh_text: 但为了她好，我希望她在我拿出斧头之前自己从树上下来。

transcript.en_text: Hey.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿。

transcript.en_text: He wants me to hold off for Senate.
transcript.zh_text: 他想让我等着竞选参议院。

transcript.en_text: I told him I would think about it.
transcript.zh_text: 我跟他说我会考虑的。

transcript.en_text: - So it's over? - Oh, no, it's not over.
transcript.zh_text: ——那完了？——哦不，还没完。

transcript.en_text: He endorsed Celia on national television.
transcript.zh_text: 他在全国电视上给西莉亚背书了。

transcript.en_text: Forget the 30th.
transcript.zh_text: 别管第三十选区了。

transcript.en_text: We need to think bigger. This cycle.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要想得更大。就在这个选举周期。

transcript.en_text: Then we need to talk seriously about my compensation.
transcript.zh_text: 那我们需要认真谈谈我的报酬了。

transcript.en_text: - He on? - Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: ——他在线吗？——是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: I'm ready.
transcript.zh_text: 我准备好了。

transcript.en_text: I'll connect you now, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我现在帮您接通，先生。

transcript.en_text: President Petrov, you are now on with the president.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫总统，您现在与总统通话。

transcript.en_text: Good evening, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 彼得罗夫总统，晚上好。

transcript.en_text: Good morning, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德总统，早上好。

transcript.en_text: Your speech was good.
transcript.zh_text: 你的演讲不错。

transcript.en_text: Perhaps, a bit too...
transcript.zh_text: 也许有点太……

transcript.en_text: optimistic, hmm?
transcript.zh_text: 乐观了，嗯？

transcript.en_text: I meant what I said about Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 我说的关于俄罗斯的话是真心的。

transcript.en_text: It's just words. They mean very little.
transcript.zh_text: 只是空话。没什么意义。

transcript.en_text: I'm willing to back them up with action. First, we should talk about a bailout.
transcript.zh_text: 我愿意用行动来证明。首先应该谈谈救助方案。

transcript.en_text: I'm willing to work with the IMF to get you what you need.
transcript.zh_text: 我愿意跟国际货币基金组织合作帮你拿到所需的。

transcript.en_text: And second, as a gesture of good faith, we'd like to return Igor Milkin to Russia.
transcript.zh_text: 其次作为善意的表示，我们愿意将伊戈尔·米尔金遣返俄罗斯。

transcript.en_text: You should've done so already.
transcript.zh_text: 你早该这么做了。

transcript.en_text: I need your assurances he'll get a trial.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要你保证他会受到审判。

transcript.en_text: - What do you care about Igor Milkin? - I don't.
transcript.zh_text: ——你为什么关心伊戈尔·米尔金？——我不关心。

transcript.en_text: You can send him to Siberia and let him die of black lung in a coal mine, for all I care.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以把他送到西伯利亚让他在煤矿里死于尘肺，随便你。

transcript.en_text: But I do care about your economy.
transcript.zh_text: 但我确实关心你们的经济。

transcript.en_text: You keep killing high-profile businessmen and seizing their assets.
transcript.zh_text: 你继续杀高知名度的商人、没收他们的资产。

transcript.en_text: - That's no-- - You mean, traitors?
transcript.zh_text: ——那不是—— ——你说的是叛徒？

transcript.en_text: Look, I am aware that they were plotting a coup, but that still doesn't-- Yes, because you orchestrated it.
transcript.zh_text: 听着我知道他们在策划政变，但那仍然不—— 是的因为是你策划的。

transcript.en_text: - Excuse me? - Why else would Milkin fly to America?
transcript.zh_text: ——你说什么？——米尔金为什么会飞到美国？

transcript.en_text: We had nothing to do with this.
transcript.zh_text: 我们跟这件事毫无关系。

transcript.en_text: You... you lied to me about the Jordan Valley, you lied to me about Corrigan.
transcript.zh_text: 你……你在约旦河谷的事上骗了我，你在科里根的事上也骗了我。

transcript.en_text: I am not trying to replace you, Viktor.
transcript.zh_text: 我不是要取代你，维克托。

transcript.en_text: I'm trying to help you. But you have to help me.
transcript.zh_text: 我是在帮你。但你必须也帮我。

transcript.en_text: These threats of reducing your oil production, it won't work.
transcript.zh_text: 你威胁削减石油产量，这行不通。

transcript.en_text: You think jacking up energy prices is gonna hurt us, but it's just extortion.
transcript.zh_text: 你以为抬高能源价格会伤害到我们，但这只是敲诈。

transcript.en_text: And I will not respond to extortion. Now, I'll send your traitor back, but you've got to stop seizing companies and making people disappear.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会回应敲诈。我会送你的叛徒回去，但你必须停止没收公司和让人消失。

transcript.en_text: Igor Milkin is worse than a traitor. He's an American puppet.
transcript.zh_text: 伊戈尔·米尔金比叛徒还糟。他是美国的傀儡。

transcript.en_text: Regime change, that's extortion.
transcript.zh_text: 政权更迭，那才是敲诈。

transcript.en_text: Yes, but they acted on their own. You're being paranoid.
transcript.zh_text: 是的但他们是自己行动的。你太偏执了。

transcript.en_text: Send him back. No terms.
transcript.zh_text: 把他送回来。没有条件。

transcript.en_text: We're not going to get anywhere if you're not willing to negotiate.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你不愿意谈判，我们不会有结果的。

transcript.en_text: Well... then I believe we're finished.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯……那我想我们谈完了。

transcript.en_text: And I believe you're right. Thank you, Mr. President.
transcript.zh_text: 我也这么认为。谢谢你，总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Put Milkin in a secure location. He's not going anywhere.
transcript.zh_text: 把米尔金安排到一个安全地方。他哪儿也不去。

transcript.en_text: Mr. Milkin.
transcript.zh_text: 米尔金先生。

transcript.en_text: I need you to come with me.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要你跟我来。

transcript.en_text: Where are we going?
transcript.zh_text: 我们去哪里？

transcript.en_text: A detainment facility.
transcript.zh_text: 一个拘留设施。

transcript.en_text: I'm not being deported, am I?
transcript.zh_text: 我不会被遣返吧？

transcript.en_text: No, we're going to process your asylum request.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我们会处理你的庇护申请。

transcript.en_text: Claire?
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔？

transcript.en_text: If you wanna smoke, you should smoke.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你想抽烟，那就抽。

transcript.en_text: I only wanted one drag.
transcript.zh_text: 我只想抽一口。

transcript.en_text: He hated how you used to go down to the stables with your cigarettes.
transcript.zh_text: 他很不喜欢你以前带着烟去马厩。

transcript.en_text: I didn't realize he knew.
transcript.zh_text: 我没想到他知道。

transcript.en_text: He adored you. You got away with murder.
transcript.zh_text: 他很疼你。你做什么都可以。

transcript.en_text: Did you wait up for me?
transcript.zh_text: 你在等我吗？

transcript.en_text: No, it's the medication.
transcript.zh_text: 不是，是药的关系。

transcript.en_text: Keeps me tired all day, and then I'm up all night.
transcript.zh_text: 让我白天一直犯困，然后晚上又睡不着。

transcript.en_text: I... I watched the speech.
transcript.zh_text: 我……我看了演讲。

transcript.en_text: What are you gonna do?
transcript.zh_text: 你打算怎么办？

transcript.en_text: It's late, Mother. Let's talk in the morning.
transcript.zh_text: 太晚了妈。明天早上再说吧。

transcript.en_text: By the way, those earrings are beautiful. I noticed 'em on TV.
transcript.zh_text: 对了那对耳环很漂亮。我在电视上注意到了。

transcript.en_text: They're Francis' mother's earrings.
transcript.zh_text: 是弗朗西斯母亲的耳环。

transcript.en_text: - They look like they're over a carat. - Two carats.
transcript.zh_text: ——看起来超过一克拉了。——两克拉。

transcript.en_text: No doubt she stole them from someone.
transcript.zh_text: 毫无疑问她是从什么人那偷来的。

transcript.en_text: The Underwoods never cease to amaze.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德家的人总是让人叹为观止。

transcript.en_text: Mother...
I'm going to need some money.
transcript.zh_text: 我需要一些钱。

transcript.en_text: For the clinic? Isn't-- A million five for LeAnn and some on top of that.
transcript.zh_text: 为了诊所吗？不是—— 一百五十万给莱安再加上一些。

transcript.en_text: Well, I thought your campaign was dead.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯我以为你的竞选已经完了。

transcript.en_text: It is, but I still need her to work for me.
transcript.zh_text: 是完了，但我还需要她为我工作。

transcript.en_text: But, what for? I mean, I can't ask my friends for money and-- Our money.
transcript.zh_text: 但是为了什么？我不能向朋友们要钱然后—— 用我们的钱。

transcript.en_text: You mean my money.
transcript.zh_text: 你是说我的钱。

transcript.en_text: Don't fight me on this.
transcript.zh_text: 别在这件事上跟我作对。

transcript.en_text: Daddy would've done it, no questions asked.
transcript.zh_text: 爸爸会毫不犹豫地答应的。

transcript.en_text: Yes, well... I'm not as foolish as he was.
transcript.zh_text: 是啊……我可没他那么傻。

transcript.en_text: Well, I'll just have to sell the estate.
transcript.zh_text: 那我只好把庄园卖了。

transcript.en_text: You what?
transcript.zh_text: 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: The money is in the trust, but the land is in my name.
transcript.zh_text: 钱在信托里，但土地在我名下。

transcript.en_text: - You wouldn't dare. - Well, I'm asking for your help.
transcript.zh_text: ——你不敢。——我在请求你帮忙。

transcript.en_text: - If you refuse to give it-- - Help?
transcript.zh_text: ——如果你拒绝—— ——帮忙？

transcript.en_text: You didn't lift a finger to help me when I got sick.
transcript.zh_text: 我生病的时候你都懒得帮我。

transcript.en_text: You didn't tell me you were sick!
transcript.zh_text: 你都没告诉我你病了！

transcript.en_text: Because you had turned your back on me!
transcript.zh_text: 因为你已经对我不管不顾了！

transcript.en_text: Oh, you are such a disappointment.
transcript.zh_text: 你真让我失望。

transcript.en_text: You don't want me to sell this house out from under you, but I will.
transcript.zh_text: 你不想让我把这房子从你名下卖掉，但我会的。

transcript.en_text: I am the mother.
transcript.zh_text: 我才是母亲。

transcript.en_text: I am the mother!
transcript.zh_text: 我才是母亲！
